# @ohmygame/sdk

> Browser SDK for OhMyGame games: local and cloud saves, sign-in, leaderboards,
> and optional multiplayer rooms.

Use `init()` once at browser startup, then use only the features it returns.
The SDK is not for Node.js or native runtimes. Do not hand-author production
`multiplayer`, `account`, or `cloud` manifest settings.

## Start here

- [SDK README](README.md): Installation, public import paths, and a quick overview.
- [Agent guide](AGENT_GUIDE.md): Required lifecycle, manifest, error, rules, and multiplayer guidance.
- [SDK starter example](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/tree/main/examples/sdk-starter): A complete local-only browser example using the published package.

## Feature guides

- [Multiplayer integration](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/blob/main/docs/multiplayer.md): Rooms, rules, local playtests, and publishing.
- [Cloud saves and leaderboards](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/blob/main/docs/cloud-saves.md): Storage and leaderboard behavior.
- [Game sign-in](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/blob/main/docs/game-sign-in.md): Player accounts and tokens.
